description: This file defines the interface ConnectionProperties in the package com.romraider.io.connection, specifying methods related to serial connection parameters such as baud rate, data bits, stop bits, parity, and timeouts.

classes.name: ConnectionProperties
classes.description: An interface defining methods for retrieving and setting serial connection properties.

methods.name: getBaudRate
methods.description: Retrieves the baud rate used for the connection.

methods.name: setBaudRate
methods.description: Sets the baud rate used for the connection.

methods.name: getDataBits
methods.description: Retrieves the number of data bits used for the connection.

methods.name: getStopBits
methods.description: Retrieves the number of stop bits used for the connection.

methods.name: getParity
methods.description: Retrieves the parity setting used for the connection.
